# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Your only writable file is the per-seat report named by the renderer beneath that repo. Read only your named source scope and necessary supporting lane files. No shared-file edits, commits, pushes, nested agents, background orchestration, build/lint/tests/formatters, live probes, external requests, service repair, global configuration writes, sibling changes, environment values, raw journal messages, native transcript bodies, or credential/oauth/server.token contents. Captured parent evidence .ufo/round-5/before-check.json is read-only. Exact operator routing: content @m_composer; audits @m_grok; connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. Never pin a model or substitute a bucket.

# Evidence
Read plans/wwkd-round-5-interactive-freshness.md, your scope, and relevant source ranges; no oral-context assumptions. Output source path:line, falsifiable finding, current/historical distinction, proposed bounded correction or no-change result, and acceptance condition. No fabricated tests, dispatches, native verdicts, or promotion verification.
